title: Starlight
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, if-clauses and the present continuous, and think about what the singer wants to hold on to.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, le frasi con if e il present continuous, e pensa a cosa vuole tenere stretto il cantante.

steps.title: About the song
en: Title: Starlight. Artist: Muse, an English rock band. The song comes from their album Black Holes and Revelations (2006) and was the second single from it. A member of the band has said it is about missing the people you love. It is a big, emotional rock song with a strong piano, and the video shows the band on a ship at sea.
Search for the title and the artist in your own music app. Listen three times this week, each time with a different job:
Listening 1: catch the words from the next screen. Listening 2: notice the grammar points. Listening 3: think about what the singer wants to hold on to.
it: Titolo: Starlight. Artista: Muse, gruppo rock inglese. La canzone viene dall'album Black Holes and Revelations (2006) ed è stata il secondo singolo. Un membro del gruppo ha detto che parla della mancanza delle persone che si amano. È una canzone rock grande ed emotiva con un pianoforte forte, e il video mostra la band su una nave in mare.
Cerca titolo e artista nella tua app di musica. Ascoltala tre volte questa settimana, ogni volta con un compito diverso:
Ascolto 1: individua le parole della prossima schermata. Ascolto 2: nota i punti di grammatica. Ascolto 3: pensa a cosa vuole tenere stretto il cantante.

steps.title: Words you will hear
en: These words are in the song or very close to its world. Learn them first, then try to catch them while you listen.
it: Queste parole sono nella canzone o molto vicine al suo mondo. Imparale prima, poi prova a riconoscerle mentre ascolti.

head: English
Italiano
Example
rows: The ship left the port at dawn.
My cousin lives far away, in Canada.
I have many happy memories of that summer.
She spent years chasing a dream.
The colours faded in the sun.
He promised to call me tonight.
I feel really alive when I run by the sea.
A small spark can ignite a big fire.

steps.q: The colours of the old photo faded. What does 'faded' mean?
steps.q_it: The colours of the old photo faded. Che cosa significa 'faded'?
options: They slowly became weaker and disappeared
steps.why: To fade means to become slowly weaker or less clear until it disappears.
steps.why_it: To fade significa diventare piano piano più debole o meno chiaro fino a sparire.

steps.q: She ___ (promise) to write every week, and she did.
steps.q_it: ___ (promise) di scrivere ogni settimana, e l'ha fatto.
steps.why: Past simple of a regular verb: promise + d = promised.
steps.why_it: Past simple di un verbo regolare: promise + d = promised.

steps.q: Which word is the opposite of 'dead' in 'I feel dead / I feel ___'?
steps.q_it: Quale parola è il contrario di 'dead' in 'I feel dead / I feel ___'?
steps.why: Dead is the opposite of alive. In songs, feeling alive means feeling energy and passion.
steps.why_it: Dead è il contrario di alive. Nelle canzoni, sentirsi alive vuol dire sentire energia e passione.

steps.title: Three grammar points to watch for
steps.title_it: Tre punti di grammatica da tenere d'occhio
en: 1. Will and 'll: promises and things you are sure about in the future. I'll always wait for you. Negative: won't. A time word like until often follows: I will wait until you come.
2. If + present simple, will + base verb: If you stay, I will cook dinner. We do not say if you will stay.
3. Present continuous for what is happening now: The ship is moving away. And Let's + base verb for a suggestion: Let's go!
During listening 2, try to notice where the singer uses each one.
it: 1. Will e 'll: promesse e cose di cui sei sicuro nel futuro. I'll always wait for you. Negativo: won't. Spesso segue una parola di tempo come until: I will wait until you come.
2. If + present simple, will + verbo base: If you stay, I will cook dinner. Non si dice if you will stay.
3. Present continuous per ciò che succede adesso: The ship is moving away. E Let's + verbo base per un invito: Let's go!
Nell'ascolto 2 prova a notare dove il cantante usa ciascuno.

examples.en: If you stay, I will cook dinner.
The ship is moving away from the port.
examples.it: La nave si sta allontanando dal porto.

steps.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
steps.q_it: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
steps.why: After if we use the present simple, even for the future: If it rains, we will stay.
steps.why_it: Dopo if si usa il present simple, anche per il futuro: If it rains, we will stay.

steps.q: If you ___ (call) me tonight, I will answer.
steps.why: If + present simple: call. The will goes in the other part of the sentence.
steps.why_it: If + present simple: call. Il will va nell'altra parte della frase.

steps.q_it: Mi ricorderò sempre di questa estate.
steps.why: Will (or 'll) for a promise or a sure future: I will always remember.
steps.why_it: Will (o 'll) per una promessa o un futuro sicuro: I will always remember.

answers: If you stay I will cook dinner
steps.why: If + present simple, then will + base verb.
steps.why_it: If + present simple, poi will + verbo base.

steps.title: Now listen (listening 1 and 2)
en: Listen to the song twice. First catch the words from the screen about words. Then notice the grammar points. After listening, answer the questions about meaning.
it: Ascolta la canzone due volte. Prima individua le parole della schermata sulle parole. Poi nota i punti di grammatica. Dopo l'ascolto, rispondi alle domande sul significato.

steps.q: The singer is far away on a ship. What does the ship suggest about his feelings?
steps.q_it: Il cantante è lontano su una nave. Che cosa suggerisce la nave sui suoi sentimenti?
options: He is on a happy holiday
He feels distant from the people he loves, almost lost at sea
steps.why: The ship is an image of distance. It matches the idea of missing the people you love.
steps.why_it: La nave è un'immagine di distanza. Si accorda con l'idea di sentire la mancanza delle persone che si amano.

steps.q: He says he will keep chasing the starlight, but he is not sure it is worth it. What could 'starlight' stand for?
steps.q_it: Dice che continuerà a inseguire la starlight, ma non è sicuro che ne valga la pena. Che cosa potrebbe rappresentare 'starlight'?
options: A far, bright goal that is beautiful but hard to reach
A real star he is studying
A song he wants to write tomorrow
steps.why: Starlight is light from very far away. It works well as an image of a goal that you can see but cannot touch.
steps.why_it: La luce delle stelle viene da molto lontano. Funziona bene come immagine di un obiettivo che vedi ma non riesci a toccare.

steps.q: In the promise part of the song, when will the singer keep holding on?
steps.q_it: Nella parte della promessa, quando continuerà a tenere stretto il cantante?
options: Only if the other person stays and does not drift away
steps.why: The promise has a condition: it depends on the other person not fading away. So it is a promise for two people.
steps.why_it: La promessa ha una condizione: dipende dall'altra persona che non si allontani. È quindi una promessa tra due persone.

steps.q: The couple wants people to 'feel alive' again. What does that mean here?
steps.q_it: La coppia vuole che le persone si sentano di nuovo 'alive'. Che cosa significa qui?
options: To stop feeling empty and feel energy and purpose
steps.why: Here alive is about energy and passion, not about being alive in the body.
steps.why_it: Qui alive riguarda energia e passione, non l'essere vivi fisicamente.

steps.q: Which description fits the mood of the whole song best?
steps.q_it: Quale descrizione si adatta meglio al tono dell'intera canzone?
options: Longing, with hope and doubt together
steps.why: The singer misses someone, hopes, but also doubts. That mix is the heart of the song.
steps.why_it: Il cantante sente la mancanza di qualcuno, spera, ma dubita anche. Questo miscuglio è il cuore della canzone.

steps.q: The song ends by going back to the ship and the wish to hold someone. Why might the writer end this way?
steps.q_it: La canzone finisce tornando alla nave e al desiderio di stringere qualcuno. Perché potrebbe finire così l'autore?
options: Because the ship finally reaches home
Because the distance and the longing are still there
Because the wish was a joke
steps.why: The ending returns to the beginning. Nothing is solved: the distance is still there, and so is the wish.
steps.why_it: Il finale torna all'inizio. Niente è risolto: la distanza c'è ancora, e anche il desiderio.

steps.q: Look! The ship ___ (move) away from the port.
steps.q_it: Guarda! La nave ___ (move) allontanandosi dal porto.
steps.why: Something is happening now: present continuous, is + -ing.
steps.why_it: Qualcosa sta succedendo adesso: present continuous, is + -ing.

answers: Let's go for a walk by starlight

steps.title: Your task this week
en: Listening 3: listen again and think about what the singer wants to hold on to.

In your notes write four sentences in your own words: (1) A promise you would make to a friend (use will). (2) A sentence about next weekend with if + present simple and will. (3) One memory of someone who is far away (past simple). (4) What you are doing right now (present continuous).
Do not copy the words of the song.
it: Ascolto 3: riascolta e pensa a cosa vuole tenere stretto il cantante.

Nelle note scrivi quattro frasi con parole tue: (1) Una promessa che faresti a un amico (usa will). (2) Una frase sul prossimo weekend con if + present simple e will. (3) Un ricordo di qualcuno che è lontano (past simple). (4) Cosa stai facendo adesso (present continuous).
Non copiare le parole della canzone.

cards.ex: The ship left the port at dawn.
I have many happy memories of that summer.
She spent years chasing a dream.
The colours faded in the sun.
He promised to call me tonight.
I feel really alive when I run by the sea.
If you stay, I will cook dinner.
